name: Cable Containment & Cabling — support-first, pull-into-complete-tray, then terminate

activities: wall/floor penetrations, sleeves and cutouts formed
sequence.note: Route coordination and penetrations must be settled before supports go up.

activities: install unistrut, cantilever arms, trapeze and threaded-rod supports off structure/soffit
level and align at correct spacing
sequence.note: Supported off structural steel/soffit; large overhead services should be in first to avoid clash rework.

activities: install tray/ladder/trunking sections, bends, tees, reducers, couplers

sequence.note: Gate before any cable is pulled.

activities: pull power/control/instrument/data cables respecting fill % and bend radius
label as pulled, dress and tie
gland at both ends, bond SWA/armour
earth continuity/bonding across tray and ladder
insulation resistance and continuity after pulling

typical_relationships.reason: supports hang off structure and cannot be fixed until it exists
sections rest on and are fixed to the supports
cable must never be pulled into incomplete or unbonded containment
cores must be in place and dressed before glanding at each end
point-to-point and IR tests need both ends terminated
installing tray before bulky services forces later removal/rework
tray cannot pass a wall without the coordinated opening

interfaces.requirement: containment is supported off structure; steel/soffit must be erected before supports
wall/floor penetrations and sleeves must be formed for cross-barrier routes
provides the earthed route that power-cable pulling depends on
every tray/ladder run must be bonded to earth with continuity across joints
overhead spatial coordination — bulky mechanical services generally routed before high-level containment
cable penetrations firestopped at close-out to restore barrier rating
instrument/IS cabling needs segregated containment at required separation from power

testing_requirements: Earth continuity/bonding across tray and ladder joints
Cable insulation resistance and continuity after pulling
Visual: fill ratio, bend radius, segregation, support spacing, armour/gland bonding
commissioning_dependencies: Containment bonded to the earthing system
Segregation of power/ELV/data/IS verified per spec
typical_exceptions: Underground direct-buried cable follows a trench/sand/warning-tile/backfill sequence with no tray
evidence: Cables were pulled into cable tray before the tray was fully installed and bonded, glanding proceeded ahead of the tray earth-continuity test, and supports were shown starting before the structural steel they hang from was erected.
